Wesbanco Bank Inc increased its stake in Occidental Petroleum (OXY) by 37% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wesbanco Bank Inc bought 6,011 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.82% with the market. The institutional investor held 22,255 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.64M, up from 16,244 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wesbanco Bank Inc who had been investing in Occidental Petroleum for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $63.10B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.74% or $1.46 during the last trading session, reaching $82.4. About 4.15M shares traded. Occidental Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:OXY) has risen 4.69% since May 28, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.86% the S&P500.
De Burlo Group Inc decreased its stake in Church & Dwight Inc (CHD) by 45.81% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 41,400 shares of the basic industries company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.08 million, down from 76,400 at the end of the previous reported quarter. De Burlo Group Inc who had been investing in Church & Dwight Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $11.60 billion market cap company. (NYSE:CHD) has declined 4.22% since May 28, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.77% the S&P500.

It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 6,447 shares in the quarter, for a total of 140,138 shares, and has risen its stake in 3M Co (NYSE:MMM).
